intro: Caretaker Folsom is a somber human servant found along the Canals of Stormwind City near the Park. Once the trusted overseer of the noble Flintridge family's estate, he now handles the bitter remnants of their tragic downfall.

p: Like his father before him, Folsom devoted his life to serving the Flintridge family as their estate caretaker. That quiet life of service came to a bloody end with the massacre of the Flintridge household. With the bloodline wiped out, the manor sat abandoned until its remaining funds completely dried up. Left alone to oversee the remnants of the household, Folsom bears the sorrowful duty of liquidating the family's surviving heirlooms and possessions at auction.
